terms.gloss: wandering, rootless; as a noun, a wanderer
evidence: Cic. Clu. 175: cum vagus et exsul errāret (Lewis & Short)

terms.comment: One who has fled his home (lār); Lewis & Short cites it only from Petronius.

sources: Lewis & Short: vagus
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 307.
